fieldValues.title: A Blueprint and Protocol led two real meetings from transcript to minutes with provenance
fieldValues.summary: A minutes package and a generic runner took two real, unlabelled meeting transcripts through ten stages to minutes, a decision log and a task list in which every item points at line ranges of the transcript; all document checks pass.
evidence: Meeting A 2026-11-25: 824 lines, 62 fragments, 17 decision points, 15 minutes, 2 decisions, 11 tasks, 53 evidence excerpts; runner check 17 of 17 pass
Meeting B 2026-10-27, from the bundle alone: 669 lines, 43 fragments, 17 minutes; 17 of 17 pass
fieldValues.body: The first test of Blueprint and Protocol since they were specified. Against hand-written minutes of meeting A the run covered every item and both decisions and added four matters left out.
